integrity: Uses published toric tensor-generation and fan criteria, exact convex-hull certificates, and symbolic wall computations; finite parameter checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the two-parameter slice Z13-double-prime(a,2,a+2,d); all other fan parameter values remain unclassified. Nonzero-degree assertion concerns torus-invariant curves only. An earlier calculation already treats a=-2,d>=2. Priority outside accessible literature remains uncertain.
title: A two-parameter tensor-generation frontier in the Oda–Miyake toric threefolds
